bio: A longstanding family-run restaurant with relaxing sea views that began life as a “chiringuito” (beach bar) and has been gradually evolving ever since. Owner-chef Manuel Alonso offers guests an updated take on traditional cuisine, the aim of which is create a range of sensations and a return to the region’s origins via the à la carte (don’t miss the shrimp from Santa Pola, the iconic tripe, or the thin-noodled “fideuá” from Gandía) and an array of set menus (Calma, Miradas, Escapadas etc)....
